issue_context.title: Single-file apps are not signable on MacOS in P7+
issue_context.body: I tried this locally, and it looks like it works properly in P6 and broke in P7.
comments:
Tagging subscribers to this area: @agocke, @vitek-karas, @vsadov See info in [area-owners.md](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/area-owners.md) if you want to be subscribed.
Issue Details
I tried this locally, and it looks like it works properly in P6 and broke in P7. This is likely getting missed by the tests because they are not pulling in the appropriate apphosts. That would suggest that the problem has something to do with a change in the apphosts (both the apphost and singlefilehost seem to be affected).
Author: agocke
Assignees: -
Labels: `area-Single-File`
Milestone: 6.0.0

Ah, I bet I know what's wrong here -- we updated _CreateAppHost to sign on Mac, but I bet _CreateAppHost runs before bundling, so the apphost is signed, which messes with the layout, and the resulting binary is malformed after bundling. Runnable, but not signable.

cc @mateoatr
That sounds about right. I'll make the changes.
